comments.author: @sabinereimer7809
comments.text:
For Flores : the place of the pond with the waterfalls is called "Poço de la Ribeira do Ferreiro " .
It was wrongly named "Poço de Alagohino" on ONE old map.
That one is a smaller pond to the other side of Ribeira Grande. 
I know because I am living there.😊❤

replies.author: @trueglobe66
replies.text: Thank you so much for the correction, especially from someone who actually lives there! 😊❤️ Local knowledge like this really helps us tell these places more accurately. Since you know Flores so well, what lesser-known place on the island do you think visitors usually miss but absolutely deserves to be seen?
